_doc: Flight tuning, loaded over the defaults in js/sim.js (TUNE) at start; a key left out keeps its default. Units: m, m/s, radians, rad/s, 1/s. Touch stick: TOUCH_BANK (max bank), TOUCH_CLIMB (climb angle at full throw), TOUCH_CLIMB_EXTRA/OD_TIME (extra climb while held at the end, and how long it takes to ramp in). Turning: TURN_ASSIST scales turn rate from bank. Energy: CRUISE/BOOST speeds, G_SCALE dive/climb speed trade, INDUCED speed lost in hard turns. Boost: BOOST_DRAIN/BOOST_REGEN per second, BOOST_HOOP refill per hoop. Hoops: HOOP_R radius, HOOP_TOL extra pass margin.
